metadata.title: Email Notification Gateway

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for delivering system-generated email notifications in a manner that preserves integrity, authority clarity, and accountability.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Transactional email services, application notification systems, service identities, and automated messaging pipelines.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for governing system-generated email used for alerts, status updates, and automated notifications.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Email notification gateways assume baseline delivery assurance, identity binding, and accountability.

metadata.remarks: Email Notification Gateway defines trust properties required for non-human email messages generated by systems. This pattern ensures system email is not misleading, spoofed, or abused as an implicit authority signal, and is clearly distinguishable from human-originated communication.

components.title: System Sender Identity Assurance
components.description: Ensures system-generated email is sent from clearly defined and authorized service identities.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid system or service accounts for deceptive email notifications.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Binding system messages to authenticated and attributable service identities.

implemented-requirements.remarks: System-generated email is attributable to authenticated service identities.
Service identities used for email notifications follow least privilege.

components.title: Notification Content Integrity
components.description: Protects system-generated email content from unauthorized modification or misuse.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation of automated message content to mislead recipients.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Integrity checking to ensure notification content is accurate and untampered.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Integrity mechanisms protect the correctness of system-generated email content.
Message routing and handling preserve notification integrity.

components.title: Authority Signal Clarity
components.description: Ensures system-generated email cannot be easily mistaken for human approvals or directives.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Masquerading by making automated messages appear human-originated.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Identity and message hardening to prevent authority confusion.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Policies define appropriate use and presentation of system-generated email.

components.title: Notification Auditability
components.description: Provides traceability and oversight of system-generated email activity.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression or deletion of evidence related to system messaging.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging to support investigation and accountability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: System email notification events are logged.
Audit review supports oversight of automated email usage.
